name: Temporary market shock pricing and expiry

tests.name: Choose a port commodity for quote verification

data.sql: SELECT port_id, commodity FROM port_trade ORDER BY port_id, commodity LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO market_shocks (trigger_source, player_id, scope_type, port_id, commodity_code, multiplier_bps, starts_at, expires_at, idempotency_key) VALUES ('player', @{admin_player_id}, 'port', @{shock_port_id}, '@{shock_commodity}', 40000, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '2 seconds', 'v2-market-shock-e2e');

tests.name: Verify scoped multiplier changes quoted prices
Verify the shock scope and duration are stored

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN scope_type = 'port' AND port_id = @{shock_port_id} AND commodity_code = '@{shock_commodity}' AND multiplier_bps = 40000 AND expires_at - starts_at = INTERVAL '2 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM market_shocks WHERE idempotency_key = 'v2-market-shock-e2e';

tests.name: Wait for the shock to expire
Force the expiry cleanup task due

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'market_shock_tick';

tests.name: Wait for automatic shock expiry cleanup
Verify the expired shock was removed

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_shocks WHERE idempotency_key = 'v2-market-shock-e2e';

tests.name: Verify quotes return to baseline after expiry
